create_SubjectParser: create a SubjectParser instance to parse animal subject data from a given root directory
load_camera_intrinsics_extrinsics: load camera intrinsic and extrinsic matrices for a specific action, frame, and camera
load_image_rgba: load an RGBA image for a given action, frame ID, and camera ID from the dataset
load_depth_map: load a z-depth map for a given action, frame ID, and camera ID from the dataset
load_point_cloud: load a 3D point cloud by unprojecting depth and image data using camera parameters
